change: Rewrote the generator to the R13 card layout (MID RO G E PR / A B N C M TM TR EPS0 / CP PC SPALL IT D1–D4 / D5 EROD EFMIN NUMINT) with 10-column fields. Adds G, the *EOS_LINEAR_POLYNOMIAL required for solids, EPS0 converted from 1/s to 1/ms, CP, PC and optional D1–D5. Checked against the analytical JC curve in a single-element LS-DYNA R13 test.

Rewrote the generator to the R13 card layout (MID RO PR A B REF / SGL SW ST LCID). Removed the K input, which is not a MAT_027 field; PR now limited to 0.49–0.4999 as the manual recommends. Checked against the analytical uniaxial response in LS-DYNA R13.

BETA labels corrected (0 = kinematic, 1 = isotropic, per the manual). FS is now written blank when not given (LS-DYNA default: no erosion); FS = 0 behaved the same in R13. SRC hint now states 1/ms units.
Theory notes converted from PDF to a page, with the formulas the generator uses.

DIF curve abscissa converted from 1/s to 1/ms (the model runs in ms; rate effects were shifted by a factor of 1000). Compressive DIF now switches to the steep CEB-FIP branch at 30 1/s instead of 1e5. *EOS_TABULATED_COMPACTION written with 16-character fields; LS-DYNA could not read the EOS before. Matches the manual's 45.4 MPa sample curve; checked in LS-DYNA R13. Theory notes added.
Initial generator + auto title (fy, Etan, hardening type) + materials entry.

Initial generator using Yun & Gardner (2017) engineering envelope; converted to true stress/strain and exported as true plastic strain vs true stress (*DEFINE_CURVE). Adds one post-peak plateau point to prevent extrapolation. Refs: DOI 10.1016/j.jcsr.2017.01.024; DOI 10.1016/j.istruc.2024.107930.
Initial CDP generator. Derives E (EC2), FT, ECC (Jirásek & Bažant) and the bilinear softening WF from fc; RO, PR, E, FT, WF, EFC and STRFLG can be overridden.
Initial generator (ported from Python): scaled failure surfaces, DIF curve and tabulated compaction EOS.
